text:
maria_cs: Quick weekly health check for AstraNova onboarding — pulling p95/p99 split by route & model, streaming vs non-streaming. TL;DR: streaming improves /chat latency but /generate p99s spike on streaming for long seqs. We saw a usage bump this week.
perf-bot: snapshot 2026-03-14 09:02 UTC
```
Route     Model         Mode         p95    p99    err%
/chat     mixtral-8x    streaming    320ms  1.2s   0.4%
/chat     mixtral-8x    nonstream    540ms  1.6s   0.6%
/chat     openlm-7b     streaming    420ms  1.8s   0.7%
/generate mixtral-8x    streaming    480ms  2.5s   1.2%
/generate mixtral-8x    nonstream    700ms  2.0s   0.9%
/embed    openlm-7b     nonstream    150ms  320ms  0.1%
```
sam_sre: Not great — generate streaming p99 at 2.5s is the outlier. Any correlation with seq length or cache misses?
aisha_dataprod: Yes — their median token counts jumped from ~60 -> ~130 on Tuesday. KV cache hit rate dropped from 92% -> 68%.
leo_pm: That aligns with their new summarize flow we rolled last week.
maria_cs: Impact on spend — monthly est. +18% vs last month. Usage increased +23% week over week. Renewal risk medium if costs keep trending.
sam_sre: Quick diagnostics: looking at kv eviction logs and GPU queue times. Repro plan: run synthetic workload matching 130 tokens, streaming enabled.
aisha_dataprod: Also seeing higher error % on generate streaming (1.2%) — mostly 429s and occasional 502s.
leo_pm: Can we recommend a config to AstraNova? Maybe suggest non-streaming for long sequences or batch_size tweak.
maria_cs: Proposed actions:
• Ops: sam to run kv/cache trace + propose runtime tweak by EOD (sam_sre)
• CS: I'll propose guidance: prefer non-streaming for long summarizes, or set streaming chunk size to 64 (maria_cs)
• PM: leo to draft cost impact blurb for renewal deck (leo_pm)
Please add any blockers.
sam_sre: ack. first pass logs by 17:00 UTC. Will try a canary with increased KV retention.
aisha_dataprod: I'll run a quick eval comparing output quality streaming vs non-streaming for summaries (to validate recommendation).
maria_cs: Awesome — schedule 15m sync tomorrow after sam's run. :thumbsup:
perf-bot: note: alert muted for AstraNova for next 24h while canary runs.
maria_cs: thanks all — will update account notes and send to AE after sync.
